$comment: The stock G20 Comfort elements on the panel target. Geometry, colour, per-photo states, safety proposal and schematic by package E (tools/overlay/catalogue_g20.py from tools/overlay/catalogue_g20_seeds.json, measured on the package-B rects); relation, evidence and relation_basis are filled by package F. See README.md.

08.note: Stock theme at night just after start-up: the most lamps lit, the check-control 'ready to drive' panel, map, 50 sign. Master inventory for E.

09.note: Stock theme by day, driving (gear D), map with a roundabout; no warnings lit.

10.note: Our transparent calibration grid (labels, L1-L16, grey ramps, ATLAS text) over the stock theme; BMW's black box and bottom-row P are drawn. Grid labels hide some spots. | F: our pixels: photo 10 runs our transparent grid layout (grid.json): opaque only on the grid lines, the yellow labels, the L1-L16 / ATLAS text and the two swatch rows (250-1350 x 440-600)

11.note: Our early opaque theme (old geometry, before bc2fc0d's G20 fit; exact build unknown). B's fit points only reach y 562, below that the rect is extrapolated. | F: our pixels: early build (eefecfd-era layout, old geometry): its 'bg' wbback widget is a full-panel opaque backdrop at z 0 (shared/shaders.js WBBACK: 'opaque black over BMW's own gauges'); no stock content shows anywhere in 11 except BMW's over items

12.note: Our opaque theme at night (B used the cb28ce7 bench render for alignment); BMW's red (P), belt, P and black box drawn over us. | F: our pixels: build cb28ce7: opaque full-panel background (C10 baked layer + WBBACK); our window was drawn, so the stockMap hole was off

13.note: Our baked theme on the car, same session as 12 (B used cb28ce7); very coarse: visual checks only. B: one photo px is 5.7 panel px: too coarse for 3 px geometry; use the rect for visual relation checks only | F: our pixels: build cb28ce7, same session as 12: opaque full-panel background, window drawn (hole off)

14.note: Our 0.7.2 connected but only our text layers drew (unbound-sampler bug, fixed in 0.7.3): the stock theme is visible beneath our text. Coarse: centres good, edges blur over ~5 px. | F: our pixels: 0.7.2 with only our text layers drawn (unbound-sampler bug): our pixels are opaque only under our own glyphs
